fact: The party advanced to 4th level after the skeleton fight.
source_quote: everyone advanced to 4th level
subject: level up

fact: Pelek is a ghost with a cleaved head who emerged from the ground in the Whorlstone Tunnels.
source_quote: A ghost with a gruesome cleaved head emerged from the ground
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek is a deep gnome traveler from Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Pelek, a deep gnome traveler from Blingdenstone
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek's mother named him after an actor, which his father disliked.
source_quote: His mother had named him after an actor; his father never liked it
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek refuses to discuss the details of his past beyond his name, calling it complicated and sordid.
source_quote: the rest was "complicated and sordid", which he declined to get into
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek was once friends with a derro named Buppido.
source_quote: he had once been friends with a derro named Buppido
subject: Pelek

fact: Buppido lured Pelek into the tunnels with promises of business deals.
source_quote: Buppido, who had lured him in with promises of business deals
subject: Buppido

fact: Buppido slaughtered and dismembered Pelek with an axe.
source_quote: slaughtering and dismembering him with an axe
subject: Buppido

fact: Buppido changed overnight from eccentric to believing he was the avatar of a major deity.
source_quote: Buppido had changed overnight, going from merely eccentric to utterly convinced he was the avatar of a major deity
subject: Buppido

fact: Buppido raves and rants.
source_quote: raving and ranting while the gnome tried desperately to reason with him
subject: Buppido

fact: Pelek tried to reason with Buppido but failed.
source_quote: raving and ranting while the gnome tried desperately to reason with him
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek has been trapped in the caverns for about a year.
source_quote: trapped in the caverns ever since, which he reckoned was about a year
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek is unable to move on.
source_quote: unable to move on
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek attempted to possess Buppido but the effort failed entirely.
source_quote: the effort failed entirely
subject: Pelek's failed possession

fact: Pelek asks the party to collect his bones and carry them to Blingdenstone for burial.
source_quote: asked the party to collect his specific bones and carry them back to Blingdenstone
subject: Pelek's request

fact: Pelek pointed out each of his bones to the party.
source_quote: He pointed out each bone carefully
subject: Bone collection

fact: Gyrgum wrapped Pelek's bones and put them in his pack.
source_quote: Gyrgum wrapped them up and tucked them into his pack
subject: Bone packing

fact: Pelek's bones are currently in Gyrgum's pack.
source_quote: Gyrgum wrapped them up and tucked them into his pack
subject: Pelek's bones

fact: Thorin fumbled an intimidation attempt on Pelek.
source_quote: Thorin pressed the ghost on what the party got out of the deal and fumbled an intimidation attempt badly
subject: Thorin's intimidation

fact: To enter Blingdenstone, the party must clarify that any drow have no ties to Menzoberranzan or devotion to Lolth.
source_quote: make absolutely clear that the drow among them had no ties to Menzoberranzan and no devotion to the spider goddess Lolth
subject: Blingdenstone entry conditions

fact: The number eight is the sign of Lolth, referencing a spider's eight legs.
source_quote: eight for a spider's eight legs, the sign of Lolth
subject: Lolth's sign

fact: The party must not carry anything marked with or divisible by eight to enter Blingdenstone.
source_quote: carry nothing marked with the number eight, or divisible by eight
subject: Lolth's sign

fact: The party must not carry spiders to enter Blingdenstone.
source_quote: And no spiders
subject: Lolth's sign

fact: The deep gnomes of Blingdenstone know ways to reach the Overbright.
source_quote: deep gnomes of Blingdenstone know ways to reach the "Overbright"
subject: Blingdenstone

fact: Pelek's severed hand was animated by strange magic.
source_quote: the strange magic pervading the tunnels had animated his severed hand
subject: Pelek's severed hand

fact: Pelek's animated severed hand scuttled away through the cavern wall.
source_quote: which had scuttled away through the narrow crevices of the cavern wall
subject: Hand scuttles away

fact: Pelek's severed hand is wearing his obsidian ring.
source_quote: still wearing his obsidian ring
subject: Obsidian ring

fact: Pelek's spirit drifts alongside the party as a companion.
source_quote: Pelek's spirit drifted alongside them as a companion
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek's spirit is bound to wherever his remains travel.
source_quote: bound to wherever his remains traveled
subject: Pelek
